data.name: Lamaan
data.long_meaning: The name Lamaan is derived from the Arabic word ‘lama’ meaning ‘young camel’. This name holds spiritual significance in Islam as it is mentioned in Hadiths describing the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions traveling on camels during their migration to Medina. The name is also associated with strength and endurance, reflecting the resilience and determination of the Prophet and his followers.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the strength and resilience of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions.

in_arabic.name: لمعان
in_arabic.meaning: أضواء اللياقات، نور اللامع، شئیق المظهر
in_arabic.long_meaning: المعني لامع هو من أبرز المصطلحات القرآنية، يُستخدم في القرآن الكريم في معاني الإضاءة والضياء والإشراق. يُشير لمعان إلى نور اللامع في الجسم أو في السلوك. وفي اللغة العربية، يُستخدم لامع لوصف المظهر الجميل أو الضوء المشرق. في سياق الإسلام، يُستخدم المصطلح لوصف صفات المسلمين النبيلة والمشرقة.

in_urdu.name: لمعان
in_urdu.meaning: عظیم نور، پہلے نظر آنے والا، اچھا لہجہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: لمعان ایک عمدہ اصطلاح ہے جو قران میں استعمال ہوا ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے اچھا مظاہرہ، خوبصورت لہجہ یا نورانہ مظاہرہ۔ اس سے مراد وہ اچھی اقدار ہیں جو اسلام میں ہمیشہ کی رہنما ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: लमान
in_hindi.long_meaning: लमान शब्द का अर्थ है एक अनोखी चमक या सुंदरता। इस शब्द का उपयोग कुरान में हुआ है और यह एक मुसलमान के गुणों को दर्शाता है।

data.cultural_impact: The word ‘lama’ in Arabic means ‘young camel’. In Islamic history, camels played a pivotal role as they were essential for transportation and facilitated many significant journeys. One of the most famous instances of this was when the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions migrated from Mecca to Medina in 622 CE. This journey, known as the Hijra, marked the beginning of the Islamic calendar and the establishment of the Islamic state in Medina. During this migration, the Prophet (pbuh) and his followers relied heavily on camels to transport their belongings and themselves over long distances.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Lamaan lies in its connection to the concept of strength and endurance. The word ‘lama’ signifies a young camel, an animal renowned for its resilience and adaptability, especially in harsh desert environments. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions endured numerous challenges during their migration, displaying immense courage and fortitude. With camels serving as their primary means of transportation, they overcame numerous obstacles and setbacks, ultimately establishing a thriving Islamic community in Medina.
